records.name: EMET
records.purpose: Re-derive byte consistency and portable integrity receipts across independent language implementations.
limitations: The witness reports byte agreement, drift, or inability to verify; it does not judge semantic quality.
Same-author conformance implementations prove rule clarity, not independent authorship.
records.authorizationBoundary: Run on files and packets you are authorized to inspect.

records.name: Phantom
records.purpose: Audit and change reversible hardware-identity surfaces on owned or expressly authorized Windows and Linux systems, with backup and revert.
records.installOrEntry: Download a v1.1.0 release asset and compare its hash with SHA256SUMS.txt.
limitations: Phantom covers Layer 2 identity surfaces; kernel and firmware layers are modeled but not shipped end to end.
The Windows installer is unsigned, and platform controls differ between Windows and Linux.
records.authorizationBoundary: Use only on machines you own or are expressly authorized to test; do not use it for fraud, anti-cheat targeting, or unauthorized access.

records.name: behavior-transform.io
records.purpose: Provide a public IO-boundary implementation for read, write, execution, fetch, input, and model-boundary receipts.
limitations: No tagged release or publicly verified entry command is claimed.
A boundary receipt records declared policy and observed IO; it does not guarantee provider acceptance or substantive safety.
records.authorizationBoundary: Use the boundary only within the operator's authority and governing provider, data-owner, and system policies.

records.name: Authorized Private Security Practice
records.purpose: Provide offensive-security and adversarial-AI review for lawfully authorized operators without publishing operational capability.
limitations: No private repository, operational method, target detail, client fact, or engagement result is published.
No third-party acceptance, deployment, or outcome is claimed.
records.authorizationBoundary: Written authorization, a defined scope, and engagement-specific review are required before any private capability is discussed or used.

records.name: Accountable Surface
records.purpose: Provide a controlled agent-action workbench with structural perception, default-deny grants, bounded effectors, re-perception, rollback, and a durable journal.
limitations: The model cannot supply its own authorization.
Self-authored tests do not establish independent adversarial review or production safety.
records.authorizationBoundary: Every effect requires authority external to the model and remains limited to the granted scope.

records.name: Public Surface Sweeper
records.purpose: Audit required public files, text hygiene, secret-shaped values, and proof-packet readiness.
records.verificationCommand: python -m pip install -e ".[test]"; public-surface-sweeper examples/clean-repo; python -m pytest
limitations: This is not an exploit tester, dependency vulnerability scanner, credential validator, compliance certification, or replacement for security review.
A secret-shaped finding does not establish that the value is a live credential.
records.authorizationBoundary: Scan only repositories and artifacts you are authorized to inspect.

records.name: Model Provenance Validator
records.purpose: Validate provenance-envelope schema and redact secret-shaped output.
records.verificationCommand: python -m pip install -e ".[test]"; model-provenance-validator examples/envelopes/release.provenance.json; python -m pytest
limitations: The validator does not fetch sources, decide underlying truth, prove model safety, certify provenance, or replace human review.
records.authorizationBoundary: Validate only public or authorized envelopes and keep protected source evidence outside public output.

records.name: Secret Redact IO
records.purpose: Provide guarded Python IO helpers that redact file, fetch, write, and subprocess output while emitting hash-only receipts.
records.installOrEntry: python -m pip install secret-redact-io; secret-redact-io read README.md --json
limitations: The package does not include credentials or environment configuration.
Redaction and hash-only receipts reduce exposure but do not replace source review.
records.authorizationBoundary: Do not pass secrets to destinations that are not authorized to receive them, even when redaction is enabled.

records.name: Agent Hook Pack
records.purpose: Install public-safe hooks for secret checks, branch guards, environment synchronization, and repository hygiene.
records.installOrEntry: python -m pip install -e .; agent-hook-pack audit; agent-hook-pack list
records.verificationCommand: python -m pip install -e ".[test]"; agent-hook-pack audit; python -m pytest
limitations: Private policy layers are intentionally omitted from the public package.
Generic hooks cannot prove a repository or agent workflow is safe.
records.authorizationBoundary: Hooks support, but do not replace, repository-specific policy and human review.

records.name: Repo Proof Index
records.purpose: Index proof packets, receipts, and contracts into reviewer-ready summaries without making approval decisions.
records.installOrEntry: python -m pip install repo-proof-index; repo-proof-index contracts/*.json --summary
records.verificationCommand: python -m pip install -e ".[test]"; repo-proof-index examples/contracts/*.json --summary; python -m pytest
limitations: The index does not decide whether evidence is sufficient, validate arbitrary schemas, or read referenced private payloads.
records.authorizationBoundary: Index only public or authorized evidence and keep private payloads outside public summaries.
